source_integrity.summary: Exact pending sidecar and bilingual staged Markdown retrieved by Git blob SHA; no source mutation after approval.

schema_and_taxonomy.summary: v2 ready daily-global-macro and political-economy-markets English-first; controlled topics, phenomena, regional scope and cadence consistent with canonical reports.

source_vintage_and_cutoff.summary: Early 12 Nov 01:29 BRT. Wednesday 11 Nov cash equity closes; Tuesday 10 Nov Treasury daily yields due Veterans Day bond market holiday; Brazil IPCA and Euro GDP flash later Thursday unobserved.

factual_methodology.summary: AP US S&P7619.38,Nasdaq25466.19,Dow52486.49,Russell2846.26; B3 Ibovespa172060.43 +0.42 FX5.56 rounded; IBGE services -0.1 September, industry Brazil -0.8/Sao Paulo -3.8; China NBS CPI0.7 PPI5.7 industrial inputs7.9 y/y; Reuters freight rate ~50% below Oct peak and certain cargo cost savings $5-$10/b.

evidence_traceability.summary: 23 full evidence URLs on 15 source domains, incl AP/Reuters and official B3, IBGE, China NBS, BLS, UST, Fed, EIA, Eurostat, BoE, ICI. Third-party freight transactions and macro forecasts are attributed to their source, not independently inventoried.

research_depth.summary: 3227 substantive English words and 3455 Portuguese, nine causal sections, competing interpretations, stocks-vs-flows, asset-vs-output, forecast-vs-observation and price-basket methodology.

visual_evidence_readiness.summary: Three numerically identical EN/PT charts, dated source table, one two-chain causal flow, one geographically identified six-area map; nonadditive measurement units explicit.

bilingual_equivalence.summary: Same 23 reference URLs in exact order, identical chart numeric arrays, dates, cutoffs, statistical distinctions, scenarios and falsifiers.

editorial_publication_readiness.summary: No first-person production text, editorial self-reference, staging/build dialogue or promotional images in public manuscripts; clarity on who acts, cost and benefit channels.

contrary_evidence.summary: Bond holiday qualification versus equity recovery; fiscal plan unapproved versus market relief; China CPI/PPI gap due distinct baskets; Brent uptick versus corridor freight declines; positive Euro-area retail annual with negative monthly.

counterfactual_review.summary: Four explicit possible paths with contrary observable evidence and no invented probabilities or cross-sectional additive sums.

pipeline_validation.summary: Editorial QA performed on source grammar and pinned blobs; automated npm build, image, index, reconciliation checks and live production HTTP require subsequent CI workflow.

contrary_evidence: AI stock surge occurred during US Treasury-market closure; no new official 11 Nov yield supports a claim of lower financing costs.
Brazil Ibovespa positive while September services and São Paulo industrial output weakened, and fiscal savings still await legislation.
China consumer CPI +0.7% y/y is not inconsistent with factory PPI +5.7% y/y because goods/weights differ.
Brent rising and delivered cargo freight falling can coexist because benchmark, freight and cargo-quality premiums are separate inputs.
Euro-area retail monthly decline can coexist with positive year-on-year comparison.
limitations: Brazil October IPCA, INPC and Euro-area Q3 GDP results are future at 01:29 BRT Nov12.
Nov11 US Treasury cash bond market closed Veterans Day; only Nov10 daily yield used.
Reuters cargo discounts and freight reductions apply to selected grades and charter routes, not global average.
Government 2027 fiscal estimates are proposals, not enacted savings.
CoreWeave expected future customer advances are not confirmed all collected cash.
Research reviewed with assistant-led evidence/SHA checks, not independently audited by a separate human editor.
Full production deployment must be separately observed and could fail if required credentials are unavailable.
Assistant-led review is not an independent human editorial sign-off.
notes: Documented source-specific, date-specific and SHA-bound editorial validation; public build and real-time site delivery must be checked separately.
